s1.target: OpenCode 1.18.18 serve is the upstream fact owner for session/message/status. The adapter may observe and translate; local guesses, legacy adapter state, and iOS state are not OpenCode server truth.
s1.currentSource: agent/opencode-web/session.go Send/ensureServerSession; agent/opencode-web/history.go GetRichSessionHistory; agent/opencode-web/events.go handleRawEvent/handleServerEvent; agent/opencode-web/session_mutation.go FetchSessionInfo/ArchiveSession/DeleteSession; agent/opencode-web/activity.go IsSessionActive
s1.gap: Translation completeness is Gate C (prompt fields, parts, list roots/limit). Ownership of facts is already the official serve, not a second store.

s1.target: Exactly one Mac ProjectionKernel / SessionProjection per (backendId, sessionId). Push and pull read the same committed Kernel head. OpenCode history or raw SSE must not become a second reducer.
s1.onlyWriter: go-bridge ProjectionKernel → ProjectionReducer.Apply (hydrate transaction or IngestLive)
s1.currentSource: go-bridge/projection_kernel.go BeginHydrateTransaction/ApplyHydrateEvent/IngestLive/CommitHydrateTransaction/Snapshot; go-bridge/projection_types.go SessionProjection; go-bridge/event_publisher.go publish → kernel.IngestLive; go-bridge/server.go advertiseSessionSyncV2Backend includes opencode-web
s1.gap: EventPublisher.publish still has a kernel==nil fallback to p.projection.Apply (go-bridge/event_publisher.go). Production installs a Kernel; that fallback is a sealed second-reducer path and must stay unused. C4 must keep the single ingest.

s1.concern: iOS messages[], turn state, generation under negotiated session_sync_v2
s1.target: ProjectionStore is the only client-side projection writer from t=0. Ownership is mode + selected backend session_sync_v2, not projection arrival. loading/empty/failed must not re-enable legacy writers.

s1.gap: loadMessages comment still says “codex+v2” in one place; the live gate is sessionSyncV2Active which follows the selected backend descriptor, including opencode-web. No code change this round.

s1.target: MacBridge docs/protocol is the only canonical pack. iOS docs/protocol, Swift models, and web types are synchronized consumers.
s1.onlyWriter: docs/protocol/bridge-v1.md + go-bridge/bridge_v1_schema.go (canonical); iOS OpenCodeiOS/.../BridgeModels.swift is consumer

s2.name: cold hydrate/reopen
s2.mapper: go-bridge/handlers_projection.go streamBackendRichHistoryProjectionEvents (opencode-web case, not the legacy opencode helper)
s2.kernelOrControlEntry: ProjectionKernel.BeginHydrateTransaction → ApplyHydrateEvent on a private reducer → CommitHydrateTransaction
s2.consumer: Handlers.handleGetSessionProjection returns Kernel Snapshot; iOS ProjectionStore applies snapshot
s2.forbiddenBypass: Must not enter ordinary live seq, EventBuffer, live buffer, offline queue, mailbox, or raw client fanout. Must not wrap get_session_messages for the client to merge.
s2.currentSource: go-bridge/handlers_projection.go handleGetSessionProjection, streamBackendRichHistoryProjectionEvents case opencode-web; go-bridge/projection_kernel.go BeginHydrateTransaction/ApplyHydrateEvent/CommitHydrateTransaction; agent/opencode-web/history.go GetRichSessionHistory
s2.requiredPath: verified OpenCode messages → pathless rich-history mapper → Kernel private hydrate under one source cut → committed projection
s2.forbiddenPath: HTTP history directly into iOS messages[]; PublishLogical as cold hydrate; concurrent file-scan and live publisher mutating the committed reducer
s2.failurePresentation: handleGetSessionProjection returns honest hydrating/failed errors (projection.hydrating / timeout). iOS ProjectionStore lifecycle stays loading/failed. No inferred empty-success, no history fallback.
s2.cSlice: C2/C4 (list/get semantics and event mapping of history parts)

s2.name: live direct SSE
s2.producer: Official GET /global/event direct payload.type (message.part.delta, session.status, session.error, permission.asked, …)
s2.mapper: agent/opencode-web/events.go handleRawEvent unwraps payload; handleServerEvent maps direct types to core.Event; go-bridge/events.go mapAgentEvent to wire names
s2.consumer: SSV2 connections receive projection_patch/snapshot only (shouldDeliverRawEventLocked seals raw timeline). ProjectionStore.applyFrame.
s2.onlyWriter: Kernel IngestLive for timeline; ProjectionStore for iOS messages[]
s2.forbiddenBypass: Raw OpenCode SSE or raw bridge text_delta must not write iOS messages[]. One upstream event → at most one Kernel ingest.
s2.requiredPath: verified v1 direct SSE → opencode-web source adapter normalization → EventPublisher/Kernel live ingest → projection patch → ProjectionStore
s2.forbiddenPath: direct raw timeline delivery to an SSV2 client; dual ingest with nested sync; inferred terminal from HTTP 204
s2.failurePresentation: Provider/session.error maps to terminal error content + idle; abort maps to MessageAbortedError. Missing terminal stays running/failed, never a timeout-completed turn. HTTP 2xx on prompt_async is admission only.
s2.cSlice: C4 (pin direct-vs-sync skip as the single pre-Kernel point; replay A1–A5)

s2.name: v1 nested sync
s2.producer: Official /global/event frames with payload.type==sync (still on the wire)
s2.mapper: Intended: one pre-Kernel normalization skip, matching official Web server-sdk.tsx:284
s2.consumer: evidence capture only (Gate A samples retain sync frames)
s2.forbiddenBypass: Direct and nested forms must never both advance syncRev for the same semantic event.
s2.currentSource: agent/opencode-web/events.go handleServerEvent default + isServerEventType (sync is not a handled type, so it is dropped). Gate A A1 retains nested sync as evidence.
s2.requiredPath: preserve in capture; skip before Kernel ingest at one named pre-Kernel point
s2.forbiddenPath: dual ingest of direct payload and nested sync; consumer-side referee; recursive JSON search for nested events
s2.failurePresentation: Unknown/unhandled SSE types log debug and drop. They must not be treated as success or as a second event stream.
s2.cSlice: C4 (replace implicit default-drop with an explicit exclusive skip at the adapter boundary)

s2.name: reconnect/recovery
s2.producer: Second GET /global/event (A5: first direct frame server.connected then live deltas); GET /session/:id/message and /session/status may supply hydrate facts
s2.mapper: Same adapter as live SSE; Kernel validate/invalidate/rehydrate
s2.kernelOrControlEntry: ProjectionKernel RestoreCheckpoint / BeginHydrateTransaction / IngestLive on the same (backendId, sessionId) Kernel
s2.consumer: ProjectionStore applyFrame snapshot/patch; gap → get_session_projection pull
s2.forbiddenBypass: No iOS history merge, content-similarity dedup, raw catch-up writer, or local completion guess.
s2.currentSource: agent/opencode-web/events.go SSE reconnect/subscribe; go-bridge/projection_kernel.go RestoreCheckpoint/BeginHydrateTransaction; iOS ProjectionStore.swift scheduleRecoveryPull/applyFrame; ChatViewModel+MessageSync.swift loadMessages HARD-GATE when sessionSyncV2Active
s2.requiredPath: reconnect observation may read server messages/status, then validate/invalidate/rehydrate the same Kernel, resume via checkpoint/fence/full-or-delta projection
s2.forbiddenPath: history merge on iOS; inferred healthy terminal; treating session.created as replay success (A5)
s2.failurePresentation: Mismatch/gap → invalidated + pull. Failed pull stays failed/loading. Never synthesize finish=stop from empty reload status.
s2.cSlice: C4 (replay A5: busy-at-disconnect, live delta after server.connected, terminal idle on second SSE)

s2.name: prompt/abort/rename/archive/delete/list/model requests
s2.producer: iOS RPC → go-bridge handlers → agent/opencode-web HTTP (prompt_async, abort, PATCH, DELETE, GET /session, GET /provider)
s2.mapper: request/control path only; timeline effects re-enter through observation/Kernel
s2.kernelOrControlEntry: HTTP 2xx may refresh catalog/metadata (signalCatalogRefresh). Prompt/abort do not write SessionProjection themselves.
s2.consumer: catalog invalidation; subsequent SSE/hydrate is the timeline path
s2.onlyWriter: Kernel for timeline; catalog APIs for session list metadata
s2.forbiddenBypass: HTTP 2xx must not manufacture a confirmed turn, assistant completion, or timeline content.
s2.currentSource: agent/opencode-web/session.go Send (returns on 204); go-bridge/handlers.go send/abort; session_mutation.go ArchiveSession/DeleteSession; sessions.go ListSessions; models.go AvailableModels; events.go session.created/deleted → signalCatalogRefresh
s2.requiredPath: prompt/abort/rename/archive/delete/list/model remain control/request; resulting timeline effects re-enter observation/Kernel
s2.forbiddenPath: treating prompt_async 204 as turn_completed; list HTTP as messages[]; filesystem existence as session truth
s2.failurePresentation: HTTP errors surface as send/abort/mutation failures. Catalog refresh is not a fake session. Missing SessionRenamer on opencode-web is absence, not a silent no-op success.
s2.cSlice: C2 list/get; C3 prompt fields; C5 models; C7 rename (source-only sample gate)

s2.name: permission
s2.producer: Official permission.asked SSE + GET /permission; reply POST /session/:id/permissions/:id {response:once|always|reject}
s2.mapper: events.go handlePermissionAsked → core.EventPermissionRequest; go-bridge/events.go mapAgentEvent → permission_request; permissions.go RespondSessionPermission folds allow→once, always→always, deny→reject
s2.kernelOrControlEntry: EventPublisher IngestLive reduces canonical permission_request/permission_resolved. Raw control presentation is allowed but must not write messages[].
s2.consumer: SSV2: projected permission part. Legacy: permission_request event sealed from SSV2 raw fanout.
s2.onlyWriter: Kernel for canonical permission state; ProjectionStore for iOS timeline card; not ChatViewModel messages[] from raw
s2.forbiddenBypass: permission raw control must not write messages[] or execution. Do not treat reject as healthy stop.
s2.currentSource: agent/opencode-web/events.go handlePermissionAsked; agent/opencode-web/permissions.go RespondSessionPermission; go-bridge/events.go EventPermissionRequest; go-bridge/projection_reducer_permission_test.go
s2.requiredPath: permission_request/resolved through Kernel; raw control presentation without messages[] writes; A6 once/always/reject
s2.forbiddenPath: raw permission frames writing messages[]; inferring always as restart-surviving grant; reject → finish=stop
s2.failurePresentation: A6 reject: finish=tool-calls, idle, pending cleared. Reply HTTP errors stay pending/failed. No inferred completion.

s2.name: structured question
s2.mapper: Target: core user_input_requested and user_input_resolved only. go-bridge/events.go already maps EventUserInputRequested and treats EventQuestionAsked as derived-legacy (EventPublisher must not ingest question_asked).
s2.kernelOrControlEntry: Kernel user_input_requested/resolved. Legacy question_asked/question_resolved are one-way presentation and must not re-enter Kernel.
s2.consumer: SSV2: user_input part via ProjectionStore. Must not deliver raw question_* to an SSV2 client.
s2.forbiddenBypass: Do not invent question_resolved as an official OpenCode event. Do not map permission to question. Do not ingest legacy question frames back into Kernel.
s2.currentSource: go-bridge/events.go EventQuestionAsked/EventUserInputRequested; go-bridge/event_publisher.go isDerivedLegacyQuestionEvent skip IngestLive; agent/opencode-web has no question SSE handler yet (C6)
s2.requiredPath: official asked/replied/rejected → canonical user_input_requested and user_input_resolved into Kernel
s2.forbiddenPath: question_resolved as official OpenCode event; permission-as-question; legacy question raw to SSV2 client; Kernel ingest of question_asked
s2.failurePresentation: A7 reject: idle, pending cleared, not healthy stop. Missing question path is unsupported/absent, not a fake resolve.

s2.mapper: Control-plane only. events.go currently ignores todo.updated (phase 1). Target: EventPlan/todos_updated control-plane, not timeline parts.
s2.kernelOrControlEntry: Explicit control-plane exception. Must not enter SessionProjection timeline.
s2.consumer: iOS todo dock / control-plane events if advertised. Not messages[].
s2.onlyWriter: none on timeline; control-plane publisher if C6 advertises todos
s2.forbiddenBypass: Do not invent hash/content/position ids. Do not smuggle todos into timeline parts.
s2.currentSource: agent/opencode-web/events.go todo.updated comment-ignored; go-bridge/events.go EventPlan → todos_updated; WireDescriptor does not advertise todos
s2.requiredPath: todo.updated + GET /todo as control-plane; A8 replacement semantics; UnifiedTodo has no id
s2.forbiddenPath: todo events in SessionProjection timeline; synthetic ids; treating ignore-as-implemented
s2.failurePresentation: Until C6, todos are absent from advertisement. Absence is honest, not an empty completed plan.

s2.mapper: EventPublisher per-connection dispatch of projection_snapshot / projection_patch / sync_invalidate (same envelope as other events; no parallel websocket)
s2.kernelOrControlEntry: EventPublisher.publish with projection frames; shouldDeliverRawEventLocked omits raw timeline to SSV2 connections
s2.consumer: iOS CCCodeBridgeTransport routes frames to ProjectionStore.applyFrame
s2.onlyWriter: Kernel head is the only payload; connections do not reduce a second copy
s2.forbiddenBypass: No parallel projection SSE. Raw timeline-semantic events must not fan out to session_sync_v2 connections.
s2.currentSource: go-bridge/event_publisher.go publish/shouldDeliverRawEventLocked; go-bridge/projection_kernel.go Snapshot/FlushProjectionPatch; docs/protocol/bridge-v1.md Session Projection Stream; iOS CCCodeBridgeTransport.swift applyFrame routing

s2.forbiddenPath: raw text_delta to SSV2; second projection pipe; mailbox raw as active timeline
s2.failurePresentation: Delivery failure stays loading/invalidated and pulls get_session_projection. No automatic legacy raw resume.
